items.quote: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
items.claim: Abraham got up early in the morning and went back to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
items.action: got up early and went to
items.object: the place where he stood before the LORD
items.place: the place where Abraham stood before the LORD
items.mechanism: narrative statement in the source text (Genesis 19:27)

items.quote: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
items.claim: Abraham looked toward Sodom, Gomorrah and the whole plain and saw smoke rising from the land like the smoke of a furnace.
items.object: smoke rising from the country like the smoke of a furnace
items.place: Sodom and Gomorrah and all the land of the plain
items.mechanism: narrative statement in the source text (Genesis 19:28); the text gives no cause for the smoke
